_doc: How an item changes face (DEEP-29 11A.4 Decision 3; WSU-58 S2): vera/canvas/item_core.transition and VeraItem.transition (vera/ui/vera_item.js) must give these answers. 'cases' are the rule written out (want = the fields named); 'grid' is every face state [face, state, locked, back, dock, pilled] x every event, generated from the Python half (python tests/test_item_faces.py --write) - the JS half must match it exactly.

cases.name: a tile pilled by the person is the person's pill
the person's pill clicked opens back into the layout
a pill the layout made, clicked, opens as a window over the desk (WSU-55)
...but in the slots arrangement it is wanted in the layout (LV-5)
a pill opened as a window, sent back, is the layout's pill again
a pill opened as a window, Esc, is the layout's pill again
a pill opened as a window, its pill control: the layout's pill (not the person's)
a pill opened as a window and carried is a tile where it is let go
unpill: the person's pill is a tile
a tile the layout has no room for after a resize is a window (window mode)
O2: a window stays on blur
O2: a window stays on focus
a window sent back (its dock control) is a tile
Esc on a window sends it back
a window carried stays a window where it is let go
a window carried to the pills is a pill
a window let go after a resize is decided again: a tile (the layout may make it a window again)
a window's pill control: the person's pill
max fills the desk and remembers the face it came from
max again (restore) gives the face back
Esc on a full item gives the face back
a pill made full returns to a pill
a window made full returns to the window (and keeps where it docks)
...restored, it is that window again
pill on a full item: it stays full, and comes back a pill
unpill on a full item that came from a pill: it comes back a tile
a full item carried goes back to the desk where it is let go
a full item from a pill carried onto the desk is a tile
a full item carried to the pills is a pill
send_back is for windows only: a full item stays
Esc on a tile changes nothing
a pill carried onto the desk is a tile
a tile carried to the pills is a pill (kept the person's pill if it was)
locked: the pill control does nothing
locked: not carried
locked: not resized
locked: the layout has no room - it stays a tile
locked: the layout does not send it to the border
locked: a locked pill does not open
locked: the person can still fill the desk with it
locked in place.locked counts
lock keeps the face
unlock keeps the face
park: a pill on the shelf, whatever it was
park: a full item leaves the desk too
parked: max does nothing (only now / pinned items fill the desk)
parked: the pill control and a drag do nothing
unpark: back into the now band as a tile
a parked item pinned comes back pinned, a tile
pin and unpin keep the face
unpin
hidden: nothing reaches it but unpark
hidden: unpark brings it back
the layout sends a tile to the border: the layout's pill
the layout brings its own pill back
the layout never opens the person's pill
the layout never moves a window or a full item to the border
the layout never windows a pill
an unknown event changes nothing
a block with no face reads as a tile; a record face 'pill' is the person's pill
a parked record that still says 'window' (canvas.park keeps the face) is a pill on the shelf
